mentions.name: Creative People Survival Guide
mentions.description: A survival guide for creative people that answers questions the author had but found no answers for, covering why receiving feedback hurts, how to filter conversations that assess versus antagonize, and how creativity can be a process of self-care and how to maximize its benefit. The guide is a work in progress with more topics to be added.
mentions.problem: Creative people have questions about handling feedback, distinguishing assessing from antagonizing conversations, and using creativity as self-care that no one had answers for.
mentions.audience: Creative people like the author, particularly sci-fi authors and artists (per the guide's URL)
mentions.source_excerpt: I started working on a survival guide for creative people like me to answer all the questions I was asking but no one had answers for.
mentions.author: Jaauthor
